issues.description: The problem statement for Aufgabe 03 asks for the names and types of all swimming pools and the name and all population counts of the associated municipalities, but the solution query selects Schwimmbad.id instead of Schwimmbad.name. This contradicts the requested output column (name) and will confuse students comparing their results to the reference solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the solution with the problem statement by selecting Schwimmbad.name instead of Schwimmbad.id in solution_repository/aufgabe03.sql (i.e., use SELECT Schwimmbad.name, Schwimmbad.art AS Art, Gemeinde.name, Gemeinde.einwohner_m, Gemeinde.einwohner_w ...). Alternatively, if the intention was to return the pool ID, update the problem statement to request IDs rather than names.

issues.description: The problem statement (Aufgabe 03) requests the names and types of all Schwimmbäder, but the solution query selects Schwimmbad.id instead of Schwimmbad.name. This is an attribute naming/representation mismatch: the conceptual entity 'Name des Schwimmbads' in the task is represented as 'id' in the solution, which breaks the direct mapping students must make from the requirement to the implementation.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the attribute used for the Schwimmbad name across artifacts. In the solution replace 'Schwimmbad.id' with 'Schwimmbad.name' (e.g. SELECT Schwimmbad.name, Schwimmbad.art, ...). Update the template to show/select Schwimmbad.name as well so students can clearly map the task's 'Namen' requirement to the correct column.
